headline: Recommended approval of the amended FY 2027 budget, which adjusts for higher state charter tuition and school choice costs.
summary: Members voted 3-0 to recommend approval of the amended FY 2027 budget, which adjusts for new state figures. Leaders also discussed a projected $20 million deficit when Student Opportunity Act funding ends, plus a drop of about 800 students in enrollment.
decisions: Recommended approval of the amended FY 2027 budget to the full committee, 3-0.
discussion: Enrollment decline: Members asked where about 800 students went and how this year's drop compares with past years.
Budget deficit plan: Options raised include reviewing vacancies, transportation, charter and out-of-district tuition, and building leases, with the aim of keeping cuts away from classrooms.
Community engagement: Members called for public outreach on the shortfall and asked for a working session before the end of the year, with wider notice of the meeting.
Student recruitment: Staff described efforts to recruit and keep students, including parent conversations, advanced course promotion, and a marketing campaign.

decision_evidence.quote: vote to recommend to the full committee the approval of FY 2027 amended budget. ... Miss Monroe-Naylor? Yes, more than sufficient votes. This matter passes.
